An unexpectedly positive experience in the context of the popular (and false) mythology that the Montenegrian medical services are below par.
A highly professional and experienced therapist with deep understanding of patients' psychology (a trait many skilled doctors usually lack), great location of the office next door to Dom Zdravlja, two pharmacies in cross-eyed proximity stocked with all necessary medicines - this unique combination of trumps leaves no hope to your flu (or whatever misfortune tried to spoil your stay in sunny Bar). Highly recommended.
